digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 24 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.summary_zh: 来自资深工程师实战沉淀的 AI 技能库，把个人经验直接变成 Agent 的工程素养

repos.name: affaan-m/ECC
repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencod
repos.summary_zh: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化系统，集成技能、记忆与安全机制，驱动研究优先的自主开发

repos.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
repos.description: The agent that grows with you
repos.summary_zh: 随你成长的智能体框架，用自适应记忆让AI持续进化并贴合个人需求

repos.name: anomalyco/opencode
repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: 开源编码代理让 AI 自主写代码跑测试改 Bug，支持多模型协作与终端交互

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
repos.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
repos.summary_zh: 浏览器里的真实间谍卫星模拟器，用实况数据在逼真3D地球上进行开源空间情报分析

repos.name: mlc-ai/web-llm
repos.description: High-performance In-browser LLM Inference Engine
repos.summary_zh: 浏览器内直接跑大模型的高性能推理引擎，免后端部署，数据不出端即可实现私密 AI 应用

repos.name: bikini/exploitarium
repos.description: A single archive of public exploit PoCs and vulnerability research writeups. At the time I post these, none have been reported. Feel free to report th
repos.summary_zh: 聚合未公开漏洞PoC与研究报告的单一存档，发布时均未被上报，可自行提交抢注CVE编号

repos.name: lexmount/moli
repos.description: Best headless browser for AI agents. Lite, Fast, High-Compatibility. Built in Rust
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的轻量高速浏览器内核，专为 AI Agent 提供高兼容无头浏览方案

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: sgl-project/sglang
repos.description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
repos.summary_zh: 大模型与多模态模型的高性能推理框架，吞吐量提升数倍且兼容主流模型架构

repos.name: facebook/zstd
repos.description: Zstandard - Fast real-time compression algorithm
repos.summary_zh: 极速实时压缩算法，比 zlib 快数倍且压缩率相当，兼顾速度与体积的工业级默认选择

repos.name: amitshekhariitbhu/llm-inference-engineering
repos.description: Learn LLM Inference Engineering step by step - from KV cache, PagedAttention, and continuous batching to vLLM, SGLang, and GPUs.
repos.summary_zh: 从KV缓存到vLLM的LLM推理优化全指南，手把手教你搞定推理性能瓶颈

repos.name: XHToken/Spark-X2.5
repos.description: Spark-x2.5 open model series. Pushing the Limits of Agentic Capabilities in On-Device Models
repos.summary_zh: 端侧模型也能驾驭复杂智能体任务，开源轻量方案把Agent能力直接塞进设备里

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: jingyaogong/minimind
repos.description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
repos.summary_zh: 从零训练64M参数大模型仅需2小时，让个人开发者也能低成本入门LLM底层原理

repos.name: google-research/timesfm
repos.description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
repos.summary_zh: 谷歌开源的时间序列预测基础模型，零样本即可处理金融、气象等多元时序任务

repos.name: MakazhanAlpamys/Soup
repos.description: Fine-tune LLMs from one YAML. Layer streaming trains an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 一份 YAML 配置即可微调大模型，流式分层训练让 8B 模型跑进 4GB 显存笔记本

repos.name: hewanglanhao/deepvision-studio
repos.description: Interactive deep learning lab for visualizing forward/backpropagation, training real PyTorch models, and exploring CNNs, Transformers, RNNs, and AI hi
repos.summary_zh: 交互式深度学习实验台，实时可视化前向反向传播并训练真实PyTorch模型，覆盖CNN、Transformer与RNN架构

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: emilk/egui
repos.description: egui: an easy-to-use immediate mode GUI in Rust that runs on both web and native
repos.summary_zh: Rust 即时模式 GUI 库，一套代码原生与网页双端运行，界面更新简单直接

repos.name: GraphiteEditor/Graphite
repos.description: Community-built comprehensive 2D content creation appplication for graphic design, digital art, and interactive real-time motion graphics powered by a
repos.summary_zh: 开源 2D 创作工具，节点式引擎驱动图形设计、数字绘画与实时动态，替代闭源全家桶

repos.name: oldj/SwitchHosts
repos.description: Switch hosts quickly!
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台 hosts 切换利器，一键管理多套配置并支持自动更新，开发者必备的效率工具

repos.name: eythaann/Seelen-UI
repos.description: The Fully Customizable Desktop Environment for Windows 10/11.
repos.summary_zh: Windows 10/11 秒变可深度定制桌面环境，用 Rust 打造流畅 UI 与模块化布局

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: nvm-sh/nvm
repos.description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions. $nvm: 3ArcxqLtXMmBnWbbtfwQgVL3MNnDsggzgGDtXMnjpump
repos.summary_zh: 一条命令切换多个 Node.js 版本，开发测试环境管理从未如此丝滑

repos.name: abi/screenshot-to-code
repos.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
repos.summary_zh: 截图直接生成前端代码，支持 Tailwind、React 和 Vue，设计稿秒变可维护工程

repos.name: rust-unofficial/awesome-rust
repos.description: A curated list of Rust code and resources.
repos.summary_zh: Rust 学习与开发资源精选清单，从入门到进阶一网打尽，堪称社区最全导航

repos.name: astral-sh/ruff
repos.description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的极速 Python 检查与格式化工具，比同类快 10-100 倍且零配置即可替代 Flake8 和 Black

papers.title: UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons
papers.abstract: Recent advances in automatic rigging now deliver animation-ready 3D assets at scale, yet generating the motion to drive them remains a bottleneck. Existing learned animators are topology-constrained:
papers.summary_zh: 提出统一骨架动画框架UniMate，无需类别模板或微调即可驱动任意拓扑骨架，通过跨骨架注意力机制实现零样本泛化，动作质量超越现有方法

papers.title: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
papers.abstract: Recent advances in wearable sensing enable continuous monitoring of physiological and behavioral signals, yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether AI systems can reason over a real user's longi
papers.summary_zh: 提出可穿戴健康推理基准 WearableQA，含 4084 道十选一题，覆盖真实纵向数据，填补 AI 健康推理评估空白

papers.title: RegionFed: Federated Learning for Personalized Query Understanding in Heterogeneous Retail Environments
papers.abstract: Retail search systems serve diverse geographic regions with distinct query patterns, vocabularies, and product preferences, creating significant data heterogeneity that challenges both privacy-preserv
papers.summary_zh: 提出区域感知联邦学习框架RegionFed，通过聚类异构零售查询模式实现个性化建模，在跨区域搜索任务中准确率提升12%且通信成本降低40%

papers.title: Molecular Déjà Vu: Digit-Level Retrieval of Published Values in Frontier Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated on molecular property benchmarks, but accuracy cannot distinguish a model that predicts a property from one that retrieves a published number. W
papers.summary_zh: 审计22个前沿模型在12个分子回归基准上的逐字检索行为，揭示其预测常源于记忆而非推理，并提出区分检索与真实预测的评估方法

papers.title: Does Your Agent's Memory Survive a Model Upgrade? A Controlled Study of Memory Portability
papers.abstract: Model upgrades are routine; memory migrations are not. An agent can keep the same memory store and still forget: a new model may interpret old notes differently, mixed embedding versions may break ret
papers.summary_zh: 提出记忆可移植性概念并构建受控评测框架，发现模型升级后旧记忆解读偏差及混合嵌入致检索失效，修复需原始证据支撑

papers.title: Variational Continuation for Double Pendulum Periodic Orbits
papers.abstract: We present a Hessian-based approach to numerically continue periodic orbits in dynamical systems. A loop (periodic orbit candidate) is parametrized as a Fourier series; a loss function is defined base
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于海森矩阵的变分延拓法，以傅里叶级数参数化周期轨道并最小化物理偏差，无需初值猜测即可高效追踪双摆周期解，突破传统延拓对雅可比矩阵的依赖

papers.title: Multi-Step Tool-Calling over Korean Open Public APIs: A Benchmark and a Data-Synthesis Recipe
papers.abstract: Data-sovereignty regulations increasingly require public institutions to deploy open-source, on-premise LLM agents that chain multiple tool-calls across live government APIs. However, open-source mode
papers.summary_zh: 构建韩语开放API多步工具调用基准及数据合成方案，使开源模型准确率提升至商用模型水平，填补该领域评估空白

papers.title: Necessary or Sufficient? Evaluating LLM Explanations With Behavioural Evidence
papers.abstract: LLM decision components that can operate within agent workflows often produce action-relevant recommendations or judgements together with explanations. Operators may use the named factors to monitor a
papers.summary_zh: 提出行为证据框架评估大模型解释的充分性与必要性，通过干预测试区分因果因素与相关因素，发现现有解释常缺失关键决策依据

papers.title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract: Diffusion TV is an interactive AI art installation that offers a tangible and embodied experience of diffusion models through a modified CRT TV. By physically manipulating the TV's antenna, audiences
papers.summary_zh: 将扩散模型去噪过程映射为实体电视天线操控，观众通过物理调谐实时影响生成图像与声音清晰度，实现具身交互式AI艺术体验

papers.title: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used as reward functions for robotic learning, but this role requires paraphrase invariance: the same trajectory should receive the same reward under semantical
papers.summary_zh: 揭示视觉语言奖励模型对语义等价改写敏感的问题，构建ROBORMBENCH基准并验证其脆弱性，为机器人学习提供鲁棒性评测新标准

papers.title: Reflection-aware Generative Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract: We propose Ref-GeNVS, a training-free, reflection-aware method for generative novel view synthesis (NVS) in mirror scenes. Existing multi-view diffusion models often fail to recognize the mirror in th
papers.summary_zh: 提出免训练反射感知新视角合成方法Ref-GeNVS，利用多视图扩散模型识别镜面并挖掘反射内容，无需额外训练即提升镜像场景生成质量与一致性

papers.title: A Deep Generative Model for Synthesizing Labeled Wireless Signals
papers.abstract: Wireless signals with position-related labels are pivotal for both performance evaluation and model training in the realm of wireless sensing. However, acquiring real-world datasets is often challenge
papers.summary_zh: 提出深度生成模型合成带位置标签的无线信号，以扩散架构捕捉信道时空相关性，在降低采集成本的同时实现高精度标签映射，定位误差较传统方法降低40%以上

papers.title: When LLM Decompilers Recompile More and Preserve Less
papers.abstract: Decompilation recovers high-level source from compiled machine code and serves as a foundation for security tasks such as vulnerability detection and malware analysis. Traditional decompilers like Ghi
papers.summary_zh: 揭示大模型反编译器过度重编译导致语义保真度下降，提出保真度感知优化策略，在真实二进制测试集上使语义保持率提升约20%
